basic_info.description: Breathtaking city views await in this turnkey condo just a block from Buena Vista Park. Boasting an open floor plan, with an updated kitchen seamlessly flowing into the dining and living areas with direct access to a beautiful shared garden and patio perfect for relaxing or entertaining. Thoughtful details include in-unit laundry, recently installed   wood floors, a private formal entry, a full bath, and abundant storage including a huge primary bedroom walk-in closet and a spacious private storage room. Situated in an A+ location, this home offers unbeatable access to Buena Vista and Duboce Parks, the Castro, and the vibrant shops and restaurants of the Divisadero corridor. Easy street parking. With excellent transportation options nearby, this is a must-see opportunity for anyone seeking the perfect blend of urban convenience and serene living.
